figures.learningGoal: Shows how a sound level meter checks a noise reading against the 85 dB hearing-protection threshold.
figures.caption: Example of a smartphone sound level meter app with an external microphone, reading 89.9 dB near machinery. This is a generic example, not Utilitek equipment.
figures.alt: Smartphone running the NIOSH Sound Level Meter app with an external microphone, showing a reading of 89.9 dB near industrial machinery.
